text.p: These are the main stories in the Botswana's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Bill under which Members of Parliament will have to declare their assets is expected to become law during the next session of parliament which starts on November 4.

- Officially opening the Pula 26 million branch of the Bank of Botswana in Francistown, President Sir Ketumile Masire says commercial banks are not sufficiently responsive to the needs of small savers and small businesses.

THE GAZETTE - Moves by South Africa to impose quotas on the import of cars produced from semi-knocked down kits might adversely affect the building of Hyundai's Pula 170 million plant to convert from SKD manufacture to completely knocked down manufacture.
